summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, client_secret, client_id, http_path; secret fields client_id and client_secret; airflow mapping with login/password first and extra fallbacks; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var refs for both secrets after mapped fields and profile args). Registered it directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings, and added it to the exports of cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, env vars, and profile-arg override protection. Tests were not run and nothing was committed, per instructions; verification was by reading the code only.
